description: Unique identifier of the order (one row per order).
Date the order was placed, between 2023-01-01 and 2024-12-31.
Sales region: North, South, East, West or Central.
Product category: Electronics, Furniture or Office Supplies.
Product sold; each product belongs to exactly one category.
Number of units sold in the order.
Price of one unit in dollars before discount.
Discount as a fraction between 0 and 1 (0.10 means 10%). Missing means the discount was not recorded; exclude missing values from averages.
Order revenue in dollars, calculated as Units times Unit Price times (1 minus Discount).
Type of customer: Consumer, Corporate or Small Business. Missing means the customer was not classified.
